title: Achiyah (Temple officer)

paragraphs: He was an appointed officer in the Temple over the libations, as is explicitly stated in the Mishnah, Shekalim, chapter 5, mishnah 1.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Torat Emet 357 at Mishnah Shekalim 5:1 explicitly lists Achiyah over the libations; Ben Achiyah over bowel ailments is a separate official in the same list.

The actual Torat Emet 357 Mishnah Shekalim 5:1 lists untitled Achiyah over the libations and separately Ben Achiyah over bowel ailments. The source’s role is preserved without merging those officials or importing any other names or duties from the list. The existing note remains verbatim.
